originalTitle: Bye Ol' Dentistry: Heal the Whole
overview: The story follows the Lolli family as they embark on a global journey of biological dentistry, experiencing first-hand the innovative treatments that are reshaping oral and whole-body health. From safe, non-toxic materials to advanced procedures that restore vitality and wellness, every step reveals new possibilities for a healthier future. Bye Ol’ Dentistry brings audiences inside these family transformations, showing how dentistry is evolving into one of the most exciting frontiers in medicine today.
title: Bye Ol' Dentistry: Heal the Whole
